# View Vendor Details

<figure><img src="../../../../../.gitbook/assets/image (9).png" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

The View functionality enables administrators to access comprehensive information associated with a specific vendor. When an administrator selects View for a vendor record, the system navigates to the Vendor Details page, where the complete information available for the selected vendor is presented in a structured and consolidated format.

The Vendor Details page provides a detailed overview of the selected vendor and include information such as vendor identification details, contact information, business information, account details, account status, and other vendor-related information configured for the organization. This consolidated view enables administrators to review and verify the vendor's information efficiently.

## Accessing Vendor Details

#### Navigation Path

**Vendors → Manage → Vendor Record → View**

<figure><img src="../../../../../.gitbook/assets/image (9).png" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

{% stepper %}
{% step %}
### Login

Log in to the CorpCash application using authorized administrator credentials.

<figure><img src="../../../../../.gitbook/assets/image (14).png" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>
{% endstep %}

{% step %}
### Navigation

Navigate to **Vendors** from the left navigation menu and **Select Manage**.

<figure><img src="../../../../../.gitbook/assets/image (15).png" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>
{% endstep %}

{% step %}
### View

Locate the required vendor and click **View** under the **Actions** column.

<figure><img src="../../../../../.gitbook/assets/image (16).png" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>
{% endstep %}

{% step %}
### **Vendor Page**

The system opens the **Vendor Details** page.

<figure><img src="../../../../../.gitbook/assets/image (17).png" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>
{% endstep %}
{% endstepper %}

#### Vendor Info <a href="#id-2vkkxaubn0ht" id="id-2vkkxaubn0ht"></a>

<figure><img src="../../../../../.gitbook/assets/image (11).png" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

The **Vendor Details** page is divided into **three main sections**, each providing specific information related to the selected vendor. These sections allow administrators to review the vendor's profile information, financial summary, and transaction-related details from a single interface.

#### The three sections are:

1. **Vendor Information**
2. **Financial Overview**
3. **Transaction History**

### Vendor Information

The **Vendor Information** section provides a consolidated view of the selected vendor's profile, identification, contact, business, compliance, and account-related information. It enables administrators to verify the vendor's registered information and review the key details associated with the vendor account.

<figure><img src="../../../../../.gitbook/assets/image (18).png" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

<table><thead><tr><th width="66" align="right">S. No.</th><th width="188">Field</th><th>Description</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td align="right">1</td><td><strong>Vendor Profile</strong></td><td>Displays the vendor's profile representation, including the vendor logo or initials.</td></tr><tr><td align="right">2</td><td><strong>Vendor Name</strong></td><td>Displays the registered name of the vendor. In the displayed interface, the vendor is shown as <strong>Zomato Business</strong>.</td></tr><tr><td align="right">3</td><td><strong>Business Category</strong></td><td>Displays the business category associated with the vendor. The example shows <strong>Food &#x26; Beverages</strong>.</td></tr><tr><td align="right">4</td><td><strong>Vendor Status</strong></td><td>Displays the current status of the vendor account, such as <strong>Active</strong>.</td></tr><tr><td align="right">5</td><td><strong>Vendor ID</strong></td><td>Displays the unique identifier assigned to the vendor, such as <strong>VND-001</strong>.</td></tr><tr><td align="right">6</td><td><strong>GST Number</strong></td><td>Displays the GST identification number registered for the vendor.</td></tr><tr><td align="right">7</td><td><strong>PAN Number</strong></td><td>Displays the PAN associated with the vendor.</td></tr><tr><td align="right">8</td><td><strong>Contact Person</strong></td><td>Displays the primary person associated with the vendor account.</td></tr><tr><td align="right">9</td><td><strong>Email</strong></td><td>Displays the registered email address associated with the vendor.</td></tr><tr><td align="right">10</td><td><strong>Phone</strong></td><td>Displays the registered contact number of the vendor or primary contact.</td></tr><tr><td align="right">11</td><td><strong>Settlement Cycle</strong></td><td>Displays the settlement frequency configured for the vendor, such as <strong>Daily</strong>.</td></tr><tr><td align="right">12</td><td><strong>Created Date</strong></td><td>Displays the date on which the vendor record was created in CorpCash.</td></tr><tr><td align="right">13</td><td><strong>Last Updated</strong></td><td>Displays the date on which the vendor information was most recently updated.</td></tr><tr><td align="right">14</td><td><strong>Business Address</strong></td><td>Displays the registered business address of the vendor.</td></tr></tbody></table>

### Financial Overview

The **Financial Overview** section provides a consolidated summary of the selected vendor's financial position and transaction activity. It is displayed below the Vendor Information section and consists of four key financial indicators.

<figure><img src="../../../../../.gitbook/assets/image (20).png" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

These indicators allow administrators to quickly review the vendor's wallet balance, outstanding settlement amount, cumulative settled amount, and overall transaction volume without reviewing individual transaction records.

<table><thead><tr><th width="63" align="right">S. No.</th><th width="168">Financial Indicator</th><th>Description</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td align="right">1</td><td><strong>Wallet Balance</strong></td><td>Displays the current balance available in the vendor's wallet.</td></tr><tr><td align="right">2</td><td><strong>Pending Settlement</strong></td><td>Displays the amount that has not yet been settled or paid out to the vendor.</td></tr><tr><td align="right">3</td><td><strong>Total Settled</strong></td><td>Displays the cumulative amount that has been settled for the vendor.</td></tr><tr><td align="right">4</td><td><strong>Total Transactions</strong></td><td>Displays the total number of transactions associated with the vendor.</td></tr></tbody></table>

## Transaction History

The **Transaction History** section provides detailed information about the financial transactions associated with the selected vendor. It enables administrators to review individual transaction records, understand the nature and value of each transaction, identify the employee associated with a transaction, and monitor the current processing status.

The section is divided into **two tabs**:

1. **Recent Transactions**
2. **Settlement History**

The **Recent Transactions** tab is selected by default in the provided interface.

<table><thead><tr><th width="64" align="right">S. No.</th><th width="185">Component</th><th>Description</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td align="right">2</td><td><strong>Recent Transactions</strong></td><td>Displays the vendor's recent transaction records.</td></tr><tr><td align="right">3</td><td><strong>Settlement History</strong></td><td>Displays settlement-related records associated with the vendor.</td></tr></tbody></table>

#### Recent Transactions

The **Recent Transactions** tab provides a detailed list of the vendor's recent financial transactions.

Each transaction is displayed as a separate row, with relevant transaction information organized into columns.

<figure><img src="../../../../../.gitbook/assets/image (21).png" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

<table><thead><tr><th width="69" align="right">S. No.</th><th width="167">Field</th><th>Description</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td align="right">1</td><td><strong>Transaction ID</strong></td><td>Unique identifier assigned to the transaction.</td></tr><tr><td align="right">2</td><td><strong>Date</strong></td><td>Displays the date and time associated with the transaction.</td></tr><tr><td align="right">3</td><td><strong>Type</strong></td><td>Indicates the type or direction of the transaction.</td></tr><tr><td align="right">4</td><td><strong>Employee</strong></td><td>Identifies the employee associated with the transaction.</td></tr><tr><td align="right">5</td><td><strong>Reference</strong></td><td>Displays the reference identifier associated with the transaction.</td></tr><tr><td align="right">6</td><td><strong>Amount</strong></td><td>Displays the monetary value associated with the transaction.</td></tr><tr><td align="right">7</td><td><strong>Status</strong></td><td>Displays the current processing status of the transaction.</td></tr></tbody></table>

## Settlement History

The **Settlement History** section provides a historical view of settlement records associated with the selected vendor. It enables administrators to review settlement transactions, including the settlement identifier, settlement date, amount, current settlement status, and reference information.

<figure><img src="../../../../../.gitbook/assets/image (22).png" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

The **Settlement History** tab is available within the **Transaction History** section of the Vendor Details page.

<table><thead><tr><th width="69" align="right">S. No.</th><th width="180">Component</th><th>Description</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td align="right">1</td><td><strong>Settlement History Tab</strong></td><td>Displays settlement-related records for the selected vendor.</td></tr><tr><td align="right">2</td><td><strong>Settlement Table</strong></td><td>Displays individual settlement records in a structured tabular format.</td></tr><tr><td align="right">3</td><td><strong>Settlement ID</strong></td><td>Unique identifier assigned to each settlement record.</td></tr><tr><td align="right">4</td><td><strong>Settlement Date</strong></td><td>Displays the date associated with the settlement.</td></tr><tr><td align="right">5</td><td><strong>Amount</strong></td><td>Displays the monetary amount associated with the settlement.</td></tr><tr><td align="right">6</td><td><strong>Status</strong></td><td>Displays the current processing state of the settlement.</td></tr><tr><td align="right">7</td><td><strong>Reference</strong></td><td>Displays the reference associated with the settlement.</td></tr></tbody></table>
